title: A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture
sections_read: README固定版本、actual main/preamble完整；introduction含历史nested input及全部TikZ节点、边、图注；完整精确主张和roadmap。

Geometry完整：F2 affine-gradient holes的loopless/symmetric/triangle-free parity proof；tag cut-profile、W_l与strict-majority kernel；testers、T0+T1、selfGram E与E#、Z symmetry；uniform injective paired frames、U_o injectivity、u_oU_o=0。

Distributions完整：raw supersaturation所需双marginal与joint caps；entropy support和information-projection不等式；terminal maxflow/mincut；entropy-controlled fingerprints、raw重复类型与sample positions的区别；sampling union bound与minor branch-count inequality。

Frame laws完整：paired-frame orbit和Gram normalization；arbitrary-rank nominal exact-image cap；true intersections导出sparse cut profiles；two peelings、mixed-law actual weights、leaf joint density与mixed marginal cap的不同用途；Walsh estimates全部。

Moments完整：Boolean base moment characterization、selector interpolation；lowrank moment label decomposition的flat quotient、commuting self-adjoint idempotents、higherdegree discrepancy identity submatrix；projected-pin sparse supports；effective Ci；random unary/binary mixers uniform rank与Z reparametrization。

Realization完整：paired atoms、scalar recipe、small-table admissibility为两个unary filters；injecting quotient条件；binary bit prescriptions；annihilator classification→relaxed solvability→explicit lowrank tester routing→bounded residual compression→private-channel factorization；所有frozen entries和O(n) test counts。

Collision完整：reference key tuple Gram space、accepted subprobability不重归一；fixed-parameter numerical records；先prune再average；cell minentropy对growing rank有效；quotient characters的Walsh bound；共同key collision与scalar agreement合成同一four-hole事件。

Phases完整：no-cover rank-growth多尺度deficits lemma；linear-size cover offsets、singleton Walsh estimates；tiny cover或full-sum mixing alternative；accepting-set-family relative injection；Hadamard-rank兼容概率Ω(N^-4)；additional support/cover pins及leaf-level four-phase event。

Preparation完整：common predictor定义与quotient modulo q；zero-class exactification；affine-slice common-test second moments；Delta=0时alpha1=alpha2的synthetic-key/small-slice rank contradiction；three preparation branches、phase attainability、rare leaf-pair table filters及acyclic tolerances。
Appendix14完整：所有参数依赖、channel requirements、pin/atom/rank ledger、linear scalar record编码、collision bit slacks、mixed/leaf/error尺度；后半09–13的命题在appendix被引用而相应正文尚未读。bibliography全部265行条目已读，不等于读外部引用证明。
claim_as_stated: 稿件主定理声称存在arbitrarily large m及m点finite simple graph，alpha(G)≤2且connected matching cm(G)<m/100；此处connected要求matching每对edges都touch。由一般h(G)≤(m+4cm(G)+2)/3得到h(G)<26m/75+2/3<m/2≤chi_f(G)≤chi(G)，因此声称否定ordinary Hadwiger及ordinary fractional-coloring weakening。不是odd-minor替代，也不是cm=o(m)，不解决较小正线性系数的弱connected-matching conjecture。该主张记录自正文，不是独立验证。
proof_architecture: 先用F2共享tensor+两个全域cross-gradient identities+opposite a-bits定义triangle-free holes；补图在sample positions上deterministically alpha≤2。目标变成每个capped unit law两独立units产生four cross holes。

若有uniform raw supersaturation，entropy-minimizer fingerprint将conflict-independent raw-unit families送到不可承载capped law的terminal sets；cut盖以小端点集+小pair集，random sample union bound排除large connected matching。一般minor小branch-set计数给h上界。此law→graph部分已完整读。

主distribution证明用Boolean point moments与injective paired frames；exact pins peeling得到fresh nominal image entropy；selector interpolation避pins并保证keys independent；small-table/scalar recipe有限化全域gradient solvability，annihilator+compression+private channels实现剩余O(n) scalar entries；overlap转collision proposition完整已读。

Phase alternative、prediction exactification及synthetic affine slices将law分为无prediction、positive compatibility、zero-class rare compatibility三支；最后一支由lowrank kernel给Ω(N^-4) leaf-pair mass。此preparation已完整读。

尚未读09–13。根据已读main/intro/appendix，这些是accepted histogram entropy/nets、single-key→full product tests、common-limit obstruction、status-span recipe及rare-overlap完成raw supersaturation；这里只记录闭包及待续依赖，不能用roadmap替代正文阅读或声称proof已闭合。

construction_ideas.idea: 把全局组合构造的失败分解为端点容量与成对容量，使用同一个可行law作为进度证据。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 有限参考概率mu严格为正；候选ordered pairs承载凸紧可行law集，两个marginal cap为Mmu，joint cap为2^(DN)mu^2；对每个可行law均有同一个conflict关系的uniform supersaturation。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 相对熵minimizer在全部可行support上为正，并满足information-projection Pythagorean inequality。记录一个conflict-neighborhood删除时entropy至少增加−log(1−eps)。停止时maxflow/mincut把残集覆盖为mu(S)<1/M的端点例外和mu²(E0)<2^(−DN)的pair例外；fingerprint数与抽样尾界在同一个对象上支付。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 可把Q(Z)的候选common bases/row transversals作为有限配置，并把破坏columnheight或quadratic occupancy的同时选择作为conflict。若能建立对所有带marginal及joint cap的候选law的supersaturation，这提供一种从分布证书到具体受预算配置的conditional route；也提示单独控制每行marginal远远不足以控制matching式的endpoint dependence。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 本文没有为Q(Z)定义这样的conflict，也未证明任何对应supersaturation。nonadditive quadratic occupancy无法由单独endpoint caps推出；更没有保证抽到的配置让同一个非零整数determinant满足所需real analytic smallness。finite graph construction不能直接推出π的BA/nonBA。

source_anchors.label: entropy-controlled fingerprints and actual random-sample exceptions

construction_ideas.idea: 先枚举允许改动的annihilator，再把全域目标压缩为有效pin空间和选定atoms上的有限兼容条件。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 允许response由两个derivative terms和quotient上的pure bilinear forms组成；pin/key entries必须冻结；Boolean moment及label-support结构成立；small table对真正individual pinned primal subspace到private opposite channel quotient是injecting。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 梯度realization先在线性放宽空间求解。annihilator任意profile经低秩label decomposition分离为selected atoms和有效空间Ci；只要target在两类生成元上正确，有限维duality给solvability。随后先移除30r0级explicit pure term，再对bounded residual做保留pins、keys和target row/column forms的blockwise compression，最后通过rank足够的private channels因式分解。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Q(Z)若有保留column occupancy及height的允许integer/row操作，可先求其response image与dual obstruction，而不是盲目扰动。若所有obstructions落在一个可编码小空间，可尝试设计有限兼容tests并保留同一个candidate minor。较远接口是control theory、matrix completion及lowrank correction。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 本文的response、moment domain和F2 private channels特有；Q(Z)尚无对应annihilator classification，也没有整数lift与height/covolume预算。rational compression保持rank不等于保持整数非零minor及real smallness，private-channel factorization的finite-field无成本不能迁移。

source_anchors.label: compression preserving domain, frozen vectors and target forms

construction_ideas.idea: 通过selector interpolation和对projected pin支持的排除，获得modulo pins的真实nominal independence。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: squarefree selector evaluations degree至少u−1时任意u distinct labels独立；pin total dimension≤K；对稀疏表示支持的并集有K(R*+14)界；选点避开这些标签，且每endpoint≤14 selected rays。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 对每个projected pin空间，先挑具有稀疏label展开的basis；任意进一步稀疏vector与basis比较只用bounded labels，interpolation迫使其新labels全部已出现。禁止这些labels后，selected rays与table-coordinate space的任何nominal dependence投影到单个primal block均为零。关键是projected pins而非pins与block的交，后者不足以控制mixed endpoint/channel pins。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 构造带tag的row候选时，可考虑用评价码或Vandermonde式label使有限组方向在既有约束modulo下独立，并把会触碰fixed pins的labels列为显式有限例外。若最终矩阵为整数，mod prime full rank可作为某个同一整数minor非零的充分证据；它可与候选common-basis搜索连接。
construction_ideas.missing_step: F2 interpolation给出的tag与enormous固定维度不满足现有Q(Z)的columnheight/occupancy预算；未给row/transversal joint law或common basis定理。即便mod2 minor非零，也不保证它是analytic估计所用同一个minor，且不能提供所需q²|π−p/q|控制。

source_anchors.label: nominal key independence modulo projected pins

construction_ideas.idea: 低degree的渐近几乎处处恒等可exactify；把共同predictor与依赖配置的coefficients明确分开。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 固定label/tag后表达式为F2 Boolean polynomial，base degree≤2；非零degree≤k多项式在uniform bits上非零概率≥2^(−k)；selector degree≤2j*且例外label数B*<2^(b−2j*)。共同f的reference disagreement经mixed marginal cap转移，unitwise errors须统一趋零。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 先用Markov使每unit/有限test误差统一小；小于1/4的degree2 error强迫每个非例外label上恒等；selector distance界去掉有限例外。最后奇数g个shared-only star atoms的cut sum为零，清除gamma*q歧义，得到整个X上的exact p_i=T(lambda_i,·)+a。affine-slice comparison只对common image-array tests成立，不能冒充任意orientation-dependent测试。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对Q(Z)候选families的symbolic determinant或rank identity，可寻找低degree algebraic model；若有真正distance/anti-concentration gap，则足够小的失败频率可能升级为exact identity，或者证明某个minor不恒零。也可用同一公共test区分可跨配置比较的证据和配置各自选择的basis。
construction_ideas.missing_step: real polynomial没有此有限Boolean最小support gap，small numerical values不等于identically zero。π analytic estimate依赖real absolute value，需要额外height及distance论证；不能把概率近似预测exactification当作real determinant lower bound或upper bound。

source_anchors.label: Boolean support gap and removal of excluded selectors
common representation-existence predicate rather than marks

construction_ideas.idea: 对低rank兼容kernel保留逆多项式稀有pair，而不是只在positive-limit branches中寻找结构。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: F(A,A)=0；F的F2 rank≤d0N。two units独立，singletons的phase error指数小；完整四phase事件在leaf-pair上须determined，不能joint condition后把两侧当独立。
construction_ideas.mechanism: (1+F)⊙(1+F)^T在pairwise incompatible子集上为I，Hadamard-product rank≤(1+d0N)^2，故incompatible clique有平方rank界。独立采样R_N²+1次再union bound给compatible-pair probability至少1/binom(R_N²+1,2)=Ω(N^−4)。Fourier inversion保留四分之一主项。额外support/cover-evaluation pins把event固定在leaves上，并有relative injection失败界。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 若候选common bases的某个互补/兼容事件可写成低rank finite kernel且自兼容，可能不用positive density也能保证inverse-polynomial兼容mass。对nonadditive quadratic occupancy的稀有可行配置，这提示需单独保留polynomial事件，不能在普通limit里丢弃。远接口是rank method与Ramsey/communication matrices。
construction_ideas.missing_step: Q(Z)目前未有合适kernel、self-compatibility或rank bound；F2 kernel兼容不等于integer determinant非零。后半09–13中的overlap proof本读者尚未读，本记录只报告已读07的有限rank lemma和appendix明确尺度，不把待续overlap结论计为已读。

construction_ideas.idea: 把vector equality、scalar record和不同概率尺度分别记账，并使参数依赖有向无环。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 先固定law/pin budgets，再selector/mixers，再r0,h，再M0，最后n；N=M0n且M0固定。每个O(n) record的系数必须在M0前固定。fixed later common-test accuracies只改变onset n，不反向改变construction。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 最终collision成本以k≤56(g−1)个N-bit vectors为主，primal-channel scalar bits<.01N，record logcount<.005N。固定parameter pair先prune小cell，再平均，避免对所有opposite parameters求交致cell mass失控。leaf minentropy与mixed marginal cap分工，inverse-polynomial pair mass要由exponential/superpolynomial error支付。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: π/Q(Z)构造可建立同一candidate determinant的budget表：nominal rank、integer entry height、每column支持、quadratic occupancy、analytic determinant exponent分别跟随每个操作；选参数时先锁定结构成本再选放大量，防止把O(n)当o(N)或拿两套不同minor的好处相乘。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 这只是一种证明组织及量化接口；本文没有π的height-to-denominator或real determinant formula。必须对实际矩阵给出有效不等式并同时满足nonzero integer及analytic smallness，参数循环检查不能代替缺失的数学桥。
